note: SANCTIONS: no hit found. OFAC Sanctions List Search tool (https://sanctionssearch.ofac.treas.gov/) was queried but returns results only via its JavaScript interface, so no machine-readable negative confirmation could be captured; BIS Entity List landing page (https://www.bis.gov/entity-list) contains no reference to Siechem. UN/EU/UK lists not directly queryable with available tools. Treat sanctions as 'no hit found, not exhaustively verified' rather than a certified clean result. COURT CASES: extensive, publicly documented litigation, all civil/commercial in nature - arbitration-enforcement and contractual disputes with state trading firm MMTC (Madras HC, O.P. 755/2013 and 892/2015, continuing into 2026 as HCMA010800862020), a long-running dispute with state telecom MTNL where Siechem is the RESPONDENT (Delhi HC, orders 06.08.2021, 13.03.2024 and most recently 03.11.2026), plus writ petitions against Union of India, TANGEDCO and a 2015 matter with Refex Energy. No criminal cases, no cheque-dishonour or fraud proceedings surfaced in the Indian Kanoon index. Per project rules these are NOT rejection grounds - noted neutrally: the company litigates actively, largely as claimant against public-sector counterparties, and is a defendant in the MTNL matter. REGULATOR ACTIONS: none found in available sources. NEGATIVE NEWS: none found; note that the web_search backend (DuckDuckGo/searx) was returning connection-refused errors throughout this session and Google returned HTTP 429, so news coverage could not be systematically swept - absence of negative news here is a tooling limitation, not a verified clean record. CREDIT RATING: null - no CRISIL/ICRA/CARE/India Ratings action located in the sources reachable; not verified, not assumed. RF/CIS SUPPLY: null - no evidence found of supplies to Russia or CIS. The company's own site (https://www.siechem.com/) advertises a 'Global Presence' world map and exports of specialty wires and cables, but no destination list naming Russia or CIS states was retrievable (the /global-presence/ path returned 404). An Indian Kanoon full-text search for 'Siechem Russia' returned only the unrelated 2006 Varomet Metals case, i.e. no Russian counterparty appears in any indexed judgment. Conclusion: no confirmed RF/CIS supply trail; status is 'not found', not 'confirmed absent'. Company profile for context only: Chennai-headquartered specialty wire and cable manufacturer, plant at Sedarapet, Pondicherry, established 2002, per its own website.
